english.note: Use this colloquial phrase when the bypass specifically means taking a detour or another road around an obstacle.

examples.english: We bypass the traffic jam by taking the Western Harbour Crossing before going home.
examples.traditional: 前面塞死咗，我哋兜路行西隧先返到屋企。
